description: Solana token rug-pull screen: mint and freeze authority, liquidity lock, holder concentration. When to use: before an agent buys or quotes a Solana token, or when a mint address shows up in a trade signal and you need the safety facts first. Do not use: for price or liquidity depth in USD (no DEX aggregator is queried here); for TRON addresses use tron_check_address_risk. Returns: risk_level (low|medium|high), safety_score, mint_authority_revoked, freeze_authority_revoked, lp_locked_pct, lp_holder_pct, top10_holder_pct, holder_count, transfer_fee / transfer_hook presence, warnings[], not_covered[] and a disclaimer. Metered: 5 free calls per day per IP, then 0.01 USDC per call over x402. There is no API key: the 402 answer carries the machine-readable terms in structuredContent.accepts[].
